ssh.description: OpenSSH PKCS#11 provider remote code execution vulnerability via agent forwarding.
ssh.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 9.3p2 or later and disable PKCS#11 provider forwarding.

ssh.description: regreSSHion: Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH's server (sshd) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.
ssh.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.8p1 or apply vendor patch immediately.

apache.description: Path traversal and file disclosure in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allowing arbitrary file read.
apache.recommendation: Update Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or higher.

apache.description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 allowing path traversal and RCE.
apache.recommendation: Update Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or higher.

mysql.description: Vulnerability in Oracle MySQL Server (Server: Security: Privileges) allowing unauthorized network takeover.
mysql.recommendation: Apply Oracle Critical Patch Update or restrict MySQL access to localhost.

vsftpd.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a backdoor payload inserted into the download archive triggering a root shell on port 6200.
vsftpd.recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd or replace FTP service with SFTP/SCP.

rdp.description: BlueKeep: Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Remote Desktop Services.
rdp.recommendation: Apply MS19-0708 patch and enable Network Level Authentication (NLA).
